Bank Amer (BAC) Shareholder Knightsbridge Asset Management Upped Its Position; Mcdonald’s (MCD) Shareholder Monarch Capital Management Cut Its Position as Share Price Rose 
January 19, 2018 - By Stephen Andrade 
Knightsbridge Asset Management Llc increased its stake in Bank Amer Corp (BAC) by 19.55% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Knightsbridge Asset Management Llc bought 62,487 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.00% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 382,153 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $9.68 million, up from 319,666 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Knightsbridge Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Bank Amer Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $328.77B market cap company. The stock increased 0.13% or $0.04 during the last trading session, reaching $31.52. About 33.19 million shares traded. Bank of America Corporation (NYSE:BAC) has risen 58.64% since January 19, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 41.94% the S&P500.
